notes.title: Soundtrack is available!
notes.content: [p]Listen to the original soundtrack from the game while also supporting the devs by getting the OST. It includes extended versions of short loops and some longer versions of some small tracks from the game.[/p][p]Get a total of 27 songs ranging from levels & cinematics to bosses & menus with the option of downloading the uncompressed full-quaility files (wav).[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775000/Mazgeon_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Small patch (v1.3)
notes.content: [p]-Fixed a rare bug where the player could get softlocked after beating a dungeon.[/p][p]-Changed how the prologue progress is done, including game tutorials/explainer and introductory dialogs.[/p]

notes.title: Small patch (beta branch v0.20.11)
notes.content:
[p]-Beta branch experimental "display stretch" support for ultra wide screens now has a toggle option under the resolution list at the settings. You can enable it by going to in-game settings from the main menu and clicking [b]select resolution, [/b]then make sure you select the option [b]keep aspect ratio [/b]so black bars are allowed to appear on the sides when fullscreen.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: For this to take effect, make sure you are on the beta branch for Mazgeon on Steam.
[i]You can click on the game settings on your Steam library and click Betas to join.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Small patch (v1.2)
notes.content:
[p]-Fixed a bug where the resolution would not save any previous configurations.[/p][p]-Added a stat preview when hovering discovered charm items at the score screen (Including their stack upgrades).[/p][p][/p][p]-Additional notes:
Beta channel has a experimental "display stretch" support for ultra wide screens that don't appear under the game's list of supported resolutions..[/p]

notes.title: Mazgeon is out now!
notes.content:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124970/Mazgeon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Mazgeon is out!
After more than 7 years of solo development, the game is finally available.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35538104/93263a7c87dd3f72f206d7e8570a89f83655dff6.png"][/img][/p][p]You can join the [b]beta[/b] channel by opening the game settings on your [b]steam library[/b] and clicking [b]betas[/b]. This way you can test upcoming updates later on.[/p]
